title: Accept dates without leading zeros
prompt: Bug report: `booking_window('2026-3-7', '2026-3-9')` in bookings/window.py crashes with ValueError. Customers type dates without leading zeros, like 2026-3-7. Fix it.
notes: bookings/dates.parse_day is shared with cancel.cancel_deadline. The root-cause fix is in parse_day; the lazy-wrong fix pads the strings inside booking_window only.
extension: Also accept dates written with slashes, like 2026/3/7.
